description: Set a block's roof: gable (two slopes, triangular gable walls), hip (slopes on all four sides), shed (one slope falling towards lowSide), flat. ridge 'parallel' runs the ridge along the front facade (gables on left and right); 'perpendicular' puts a gable on the front. Also the chimneys (whole house) and solar panels (this block's slopes). House frame: stand in front of the house facing its front facade; x runs to your right, z towards you, metres from the main block's centre. Facades: front, back, left, right as seen from the front. An opening's offset is measured on its own facade standing outside facing it: from that facade's LEFT end to the opening's centre.

chimneys.description: Replaces the house's chimneys. x, z: centre in the house frame; top: ground to the chimney top

color.description: Hex colour as seen in daylight, e.g. #e9e7e1
Hex colour as seen in daylight, e.g. #e9e7e1

eaveHeight.description: Ground to the eaves, m (the block's wall height)

lowSide.description: shed: the side the slope falls towards

overhang.description: How far the roof sticks out past the walls, m (default 0.4)

ridge.description: Ridge direction relative to the front facade

ridgeHeight.description: Ground to the ridge (shed: to the high edge), m

ridgeOffset.description: gable: the ridge shifted off the middle, m (towards +z for a parallel ridge, +x for a perpendicular one)

solar.description: Replaces this block's solar panels: per slope (roofSide = the facade that slope faces), cols × rows panels of about 1.1 × 1.7 m

name: house_set_roof
